content.title: Weather-aware contrastive state-space learning for probabilistic photovoltaic power forecasting under high irradiance variability
content.abstract: Accurate probabilistic photovoltaic (PV) power forecasting is essential to reliable operation of power systems with high renewable penetration. The rapid changes in the weather lead to strong non-stationarity in PV generation and degrade both prediction accuracy and uncertainty estimation. We propose a weather-aware contrastive state-space learning framework for probabilistic forecasting of PV power. Our framework integrates a selective state-space encoder for efficient long-range temporal modeling, a contrastive learning module that structures representations according to irradiance-ramp-base
